swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB uses TO-263-5 (5-pin, KTT) while TPS54331DR uses SOIC-8 (8-pin, D); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (NONE vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW). Soldering TPS54331DR onto a LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (TO-263-5: GND vs SOIC-8: NONE); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 74% (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 150 kHz p.7 vs TPS54331DR: 570 kHz p.6); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 33 µH p.25 vs TPS54331DR: 6.8 µH p.16); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.
HIGH FEEDBACK CONFIGURATION: One converter is fixed-output while the other is adjustable; external R1/R2 feedback resistors and feedforward capacitor must be updated.
HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RANGE SHIFT: Recommended Vin,max differs (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 40 V p.6 vs TPS54331DR: 28 V p.4); verify line transients stay below Vin,abs,max.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 57% (LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB: 50 °C/W p.5 vs TPS54331DR: 116.3 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: LM2596SX-5.0/NOPB (Texas Instruments, TO-263-5) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs BOOT), Pin 2 (SW vs VIN), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (FB vs SS), Pin 5 (EN vs FB), Pin 6 (NONE vs COMP), Pin 7 (NONE vs GND), Pin 8 (NONE vs SW); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is buck (non-sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency is 150 kHz (p.7) vs 570 kHz (p.6), rated current is 3000 mA (p.1) vs 3000 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 33 µH (p.25) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), and Iq is 5000 µA (p.7) vs 110 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.4 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 50 vs 116.3 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
